author: Fouled
body:
Infraction #1 - ID: 127987
  • Player: pherray
  • Infraction: Client Lag (given by Sunaye).
  • Reason for removal: Client lag infractions are supposed to be removed after it's been given (stated by Peachy).
Infraction #2 - ID: 55301
  • Player: pherray
  • Infraction: Hacking (given by CocoaLattleSauce).
  • Reason for removal: First of all, she did not specify a type of hack that I was banned for, neither was there no evidence what-so-ever. The infraction was given on November 5, 2013 at 9:50 PM. And the only thing I did was bridge underneath zalidor's map area to get to the other side (I got banned while I was running on the bridge). I don't really see how that was ban worthy, at all.
Infraction #3 - ID: 102402
  • Player: pherray
  • Infraction: Do not accuse others of hacking publicly (given by ShiptheBattle)
  • Reason for removal: I didn't really accuse others of hacking, the only thing I did say was "really, you're gonna fly?". It was quite obvious IMO, as it was on red alert and the person was teasing me. After that, I did not get any verbal warning, and instead, I got instantly warned (/warn). I don't see in the slightest way on how I got that infraction.

Thanks for reading & have a wonderful day.
